addr: New No 14, Bannerghatta Rd, next to Fire Force, SR Krishnappa Garden, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560029, India

rev.t:
Had purchased a Mitsubishi cedia from here .
I always wanted to buy a enthusiast car and I choose classic car for that . …
Don't even try to visit this showroom "Classic cars zone" Bannerghatta Road. First they try to talk so nicely and then try to sell of the cars at higher price which are in worst condition. …

Horrible experience, my car tyre got punctured right in front of this place. I went in for help with Stephanie replacement and the cleaner there asked me 3000 bucks to replace the tyre. When i requested him to reduce his price, he started showing me attitude and asked me to move the car from away from the gate.
